title: Bounded prime-sum criterion for rational points
exact_target: Does boundedness of the logarithmic prime sum of local point counts exactly characterize elliptic curves with only finitely many rational points?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 8900013 (AMR-088-0013). CC BY 4.0.

Christian Wuthrich, \emph{Open problems in number theory}, lecture slides (December 2011) slides beginning Let $N_p$ be the number of solutions of $E$ modulo $p$ plus $1$, followed by Birch and Swinnerton-Dyer conjecture.
